en: Hand‑tinted postcard scene of a calm river crossed by two long, low ferries with soldiers and sailors on board. The men wear early 20th‑century German military uniforms and white naval-style clothing. Simple masts and cables suggest a cable or flying ferry construction. Low, flat countryside with a few houses is visible on the opposite bank under a pastel orange-and-blue sky. Printed German text appears at the top and lower right of the image.
